package task

import (
	"context"
	"crypto/sha256"
	"encoding/hex"
	"encoding/json"
	"sort"
	"strings"
	"time"

	"github.com/example/mc-course-service/internal/domain"
)

// InternalCourseStructureResponse returns ordered lessons/tasks for one course.
type InternalCourseStructureResponse struct {
	CourseID           string                          `json:"course_id"`
	CurriculumRevision string                          `json:"curriculum_revision"`
	Lessons            []InternalCourseStructureLesson `json:"lessons"`
}

const DiagnosticAssessmentCatalogSchema = "course-diagnostic-assessment-catalog.v1"

type InternalDiagnosticAssessmentCatalogResponse struct {
	Schema             string                          `json:"schema"`
	CourseID           string                          `json:"course_id"`
	CurriculumRevision string                          `json:"curriculum_revision"`
	Lessons            []InternalCourseStructureLesson `json:"lessons"`
}

// InternalCourseStructureLesson represents one lesson in internal structure payload.
type InternalCourseStructureLesson struct {
	ID          string                        `json:"id"`
	CourseID    string                        `json:"course_id"`
	SectionID   string                        `json:"section_id"`
	Title       string                        `json:"title"`
	Description string                        `json:"description"`
	Order       int                           `json:"order"`
	Status      int                           `json:"status"`
	UpdatedAt   string                        `json:"updated_at"`
	Tasks       []InternalCourseStructureTask `json:"tasks"`
}

// InternalCourseStructureTask represents one task in internal structure payload.
type InternalCourseStructureTask struct {
	ID                string                          `json:"id"`
	LessonID          string                          `json:"lesson_id"`
	Title             string                          `json:"title"`
	Description       string                          `json:"description"`
	Type              int16                           `json:"type"`
	AssessmentPurpose string                          `json:"assessment_purpose"`
	EvaluationMode    string                          `json:"evaluation_mode"`
	Order             int                             `json:"order"`
	Status            int                             `json:"status"`
	LearningTargets   []InternalCourseStructureTarget `json:"learning_targets"`
	UpdatedAt         string                          `json:"updated_at"`
	Version           int                             `json:"version"`
}

type InternalCourseStructureTarget struct {
	Type    string `json:"type"`
	Key     string `json:"key"`
	Version string `json:"version,omitempty"`
}

// GetInternalCourseStructure loads lessons/tasks for one course.
type GetInternalCourseStructure struct {
	Lessons interface {
		ListByCourse(ctx context.Context, courseID string) ([]domain.Lesson, error)
	}
	Tasks lessonTaskLister
}

// Handle returns course structure for internal consumers.
func (uc GetInternalCourseStructure) Handle(ctx context.Context, courseID string) (*InternalCourseStructureResponse, error) {
	courseID = strings.TrimSpace(courseID)
	if courseID == "" || uc.Lessons == nil || uc.Tasks == nil {
		return nil, domain.ErrValidation
	}
	lessons, err := uc.Lessons.ListByCourse(ctx, courseID)
	if err != nil {
		return nil, err
	}

	// ListByCourse is authoritative for course/module/section/lesson order.
	// Lesson.Order is scoped to its section; globally sorting it here would
	// move later sections' first lessons ahead of earlier sections.
	response := &InternalCourseStructureResponse{
		CourseID: courseID,
		Lessons:  make([]InternalCourseStructureLesson, 0, len(lessons)),
	}

	for _, lesson := range lessons {
		tasks, err := uc.Tasks.ListByLesson(ctx, lesson.ID)
		if err != nil {
			return nil, err
		}
		sort.SliceStable(tasks, func(left, right int) bool {
			if tasks[left].Order == tasks[right].Order {
				return tasks[left].ID < tasks[right].ID
			}
			return tasks[left].Order < tasks[right].Order
		})

		lessonItem := InternalCourseStructureLesson{
			ID:          lesson.ID,
			CourseID:    courseID,
			SectionID:   lesson.SectionID,
			Title:       lesson.Title,
			Description: lesson.Description,
			Order:       lesson.Order,
			Status:      lesson.Status,
			UpdatedAt:   lesson.UpdatedAt.UTC().Format(time.RFC3339Nano),
			Tasks:       make([]InternalCourseStructureTask, 0, len(tasks)),
		}

		for _, taskItem := range tasks {
			targets := make([]InternalCourseStructureTarget, 0, len(taskItem.LearningTargets))
			for _, target := range taskItem.LearningTargets {
				targets = append(targets, InternalCourseStructureTarget{Type: string(target.Type), Key: target.Key, Version: target.Version})
			}
			lessonItem.Tasks = append(lessonItem.Tasks, InternalCourseStructureTask{
				ID:                taskItem.ID,
				LessonID:          taskItem.LessonID,
				Title:             taskItem.Title,
				Description:       taskItem.Description,
				Type:              taskItem.Type,
				AssessmentPurpose: domain.AssessmentPurposeValue(taskItem.AssessmentPurpose),
				EvaluationMode:    domain.TaskEvaluationModeName(taskItem.EvaluationMode),
				Order:             taskItem.Order,
				Status:            taskItem.Status,
				LearningTargets:   targets,
				UpdatedAt:         taskItem.UpdatedAt.UTC().Format(time.RFC3339Nano),
				Version:           taskItem.Version,
			})
		}

		response.Lessons = append(response.Lessons, lessonItem)
	}
	revisionPayload, err := json.Marshal(response.Lessons)
	if err != nil {
		return nil, err
	}
	digest := sha256.Sum256(revisionPayload)
	response.CurriculumRevision = "sha256:" + hex.EncodeToString(digest[:])

	return response, nil
}

// DiagnosticOnly returns a bounded, answer-key-free diagnostic assessment catalog.
func (response *InternalCourseStructureResponse) DiagnosticOnly() (*InternalDiagnosticAssessmentCatalogResponse, error) {
	if response == nil {
		return nil, domain.ErrValidation
	}
	filtered := &InternalDiagnosticAssessmentCatalogResponse{Schema: DiagnosticAssessmentCatalogSchema, CourseID: response.CourseID, Lessons: make([]InternalCourseStructureLesson, 0)}
	total := 0
	for _, lesson := range response.Lessons {
		items := make([]InternalCourseStructureTask, 0)
		for _, item := range lesson.Tasks {
			purpose, purposeErr := domain.NormalizeAssessmentPurpose(item.AssessmentPurpose)
			if purposeErr != nil {
				return nil, purposeErr
			}
			if purpose != domain.AssessmentPurposeDiagnostic {
				continue
			}
			if !domain.IsAssessmentTaskType(item.Type) {
				return nil, domain.ErrValidation
			}
			if !domain.IsOfficialAutoScoredDiagnostic(item.Type, item.EvaluationMode) {
				return nil, domain.ErrValidation
			}
			if item.Status != domain.TaskStatusActive || lesson.Status != domain.LessonStatusActive {
				continue
			}
			items = append(items, item)
			total++
		}
		if len(items) == 0 {
			continue
		}
		if total > 100 {
			return nil, domain.ErrValidation
		}
		lesson.Tasks = items
		filtered.Lessons = append(filtered.Lessons, lesson)
	}
	payload, err := json.Marshal(filtered.Lessons)
	if err != nil {
		return nil, err
	}
	digest := sha256.Sum256(payload)
	filtered.CurriculumRevision = "sha256:" + hex.EncodeToString(digest[:])
	return filtered, nil
}
